name: sim-mcu-platform
description: 2D 可视化单片机接线仿真与测试平台（monorepo：apps/* + packages/*）

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @sim/contracts && npm run build -w @sim/definitions && npm run build -w @sim/rule-engine
scripts.dev:packages: npm run dev -w @sim/contracts & npm run dev -w @sim/definitions & npm run dev -w @sim/rule-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @sim/api && npm run build -w @sim/web
